blocks.text: Oaklands home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Oaklands?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 9 condos and townhomes listed in Oaklands. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Oaklands a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes had 11% on only 9 listed, too few to read as a market type. The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Oaklands from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 0 houses and 8 condos and townhomes sold in Oaklands over those 5 months; condos and townhomes peaked in June with 3 sold.

faq.q: How big is Oaklands compared with the rest of Burnaby?
faq.a: In October 2026, Oaklands held 0.7% of the 1,309 condos and townhomes listed in Burnaby.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Oaklands than in June?
faq.a: Listings of condos and townhomes rose from 6 in June to 9 in October 2026 (+50.0%).

faq.q: What did townhomes in Oaklands sell for?
faq.a: 7 townhomes sold in Oaklands between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,390,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Oaklands?
faq.a: The median was 27 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.9% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
